text: Raúl Fajardo Moreno, born on December 3, 1929, and passing away in July 2012, was a prominent Colombian architect. He co-designed the Coltejer Building, which is Medellín's tallest building, alongside Hernando Vélez, Germán Samper, and Jorge Manjarrés. When asked about his favorite projects, he listed the City University U. of A., the Coltejer building, the Headquarters of Southamerican Insurance, and several other works, but stated that he would redesign each one if given the opportunity to create them anew. Fajardo married María Valderrama Tobón and had five children: Sergio Fajardo, who served as Mayor of Medellín and later Governor of Antioquia, María Isabel, Andrés, Rodrigo, and Silvia. He died at the end of July 2012.
